tbesh_html:
1) to wash, rinse, overflow, engulf, rinse or wash off
1a) (Qal)
1a1) to overflow
1a2) to flow, run
1a3) to rinse or wash off
1b) (Niphal) to be swept away, be rinsed out
1c) (Pual) to be rinsed, be scoured and rinsed

strongs_1890.strongs_def: to gush; by implication, to inundate, cleanse; by analogy, to gallop, conquer
strongs_1890.kjv_def: drown, (over-) flow(-whelm, rinse, run, rush, (throughly) wash (away).
